shape_ref_yaw_note: null until measured: stage 3 measures the long axis (common.shape_ref_yaw, ai_align); read the overlay, then write the value here (plus 180 if the bow came out aft)
notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_IM5/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/hegemony_IM5.py; issue 768). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 31.0, the Super-dreadnought class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. No parts list here: the sheet places every part. game_code H4_11 is the Super-dreadnought folder the game picks for hegemony (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake stack (issue 780): stage 5 paints it with the Hegemony kit's paint stack (tools/blender/kits/hegemony/stack.py, through tools/blender/r209/bake_sheet.py; the direction is contrib/muse/design/paint_direction_2026_11/hegemony.md, approved by Ryan Nov 14 2026); the colour zones are the sheet's. No PC recipe run until the Board and Ryan have looked at the sandbox previews (docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_IM5/paint/).
